title: Travelling allowance to daily wage earners.
html:
21-C.

 All persons serving under Government on daily wages basis, if they undertake journey in connection with the transaction of government business will get travelling and daily allowance at the rates admissible to regular government servants. The admissibility of travelling allowance will be determined on the basis of the wages as may be payable to them finally for the month in which the journey is undertaken.
